name: @cloudflare/forge-sdk-ts
description: Fern-generated TypeScript SDK for Cloudflare APIs

scripts.build: ([ ! -f src/_generated/index.ts ] || rm -rf dist) && ([ ! -f src/_generated/index.ts ] || tsc -p tsconfig.generated.json) && ([ ! -f src/_generated/index.ts ] || tsx scripts/verify-sdk-map.ts)
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:scripts && ([ ! -f src/_generated/index.ts ] || tsc -p tsconfig.generated.json --noEmit)
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test scripts/test-envelope-unwrap.ts scripts/test-sdk-map-ast.ts scripts/test-sdk-map-paths.ts scripts/test-passthrough-query-join.ts scripts/test-sdk-error-imports.ts
